coupling_convention: x-axis f_a in GeV, y-axis m_a in eV (QCD axion relation m_a = 5.707e-5 eV * (1e11 GeV / f_a))
notes: This is not an experimental exclusion limit but a theoretical prediction on the f_a-m_a plane from early-universe simulations of the post-inflationary PQ-breaking scenario. The paper's central result is m_a = 25.2 +/- 11.0 ueV (i.e., 14.2-36.2 ueV) for the QCD axion to produce the observed DM abundance, corresponding to f_a = (2.27 +/- 0.33)e11 GeV (band ~1.58e11 to 4.02e11 GeV using the m_a range). Data points give the band edges and central value: [f_a GeV, m_a eV]. The quoted +/-11.0 ueV uncertainty is a combined statistical+systematic (~1-sigma) uncertainty, not a formal 90/95% CL. No local DM density assumption applies (cosmological simulation, not a haloscope).
